To: support@clockpoint.example
Replying to: m01
Cc: kevin.mutua@tausifreight.example
Subject: Re: [CP-48213] Overtime coding issue on night shifts

Dear Faith,

Thank you for picking this up. Here are the details you asked for.

1. Terminals: BX-300. The four at our Embakasi depot auto-updated from firmware 4.1.8 to 4.2.1 on the night of 27 October. Our two terminals at Mombasa Road are still on 4.1.8 and are not affected.

2. Shift template: NIGHT-8 (22:00-06:00) at Embakasi.

3. Example: staff ID T-0417 clocked in at 21:54 on 30 October and out at 06:07 on 31 October.
- Export showed: 2.1 hrs REG on 30 Oct and 6.1 hrs OT15 on 31 Oct.
- Expected: 8.0 hrs REG and 0.2 hrs OT15. Payroll rounds to the nearest tenth of an hour, so the 8h 13m total is 8.2 hrs, with the 13 minutes outside the scheduled shift coded OT15.

In short, any shift crossing midnight is split into two lines, and the after-midnight line is coded OT15 instead of REG.

4. Export profile: Payroll CSV v2.

5. When noticed: we spotted it on 5 November while reviewing the draft October overtime, but it appears to have started around 28 October, right after the update. It affects 38 night-shift staff and inflated our draft October overtime by roughly KES 212,000. We have been correcting it by hand from the raw punches, which is not sustainable.

The 4.2.1 release notes promised improved midnight rollover handling for shifts spanning two calendar days. For us it has had the opposite effect.

We need a fix or a clear workaround before our payroll cut-off on 20 November. Kevin Mutua, our payroll officer, is copied in and will test whatever you suggest.

One question I would like answered plainly: can Brian Ochieng, who manages our terminals, safely roll the four Embakasi terminals back from 4.2.1 to 4.1.8 without losing any punch data? If there are steps he must take first, such as syncing or exporting the buffered punches, please spell them out. He would rather not touch anything until you confirm.

A reply on the rollback this week would help us plan.

Kind regards,
Njeri Mwangi
HR Manager, Tausi Freight
